translations.web: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.
translations.bsb: But a man, despite his wealth, cannot endure; he is like the beasts that perish.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.
translations.asv: But man being in honor abideth not: He is like the beasts that perish.
